'''Nirmalya Ghosh''' (born 1974) is an Indian physicist known for his research in the field of Optical Polarization and related phenomena. He is a professor in the Department of Physical Sciences<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Physical Sciences, IISER Kolkata |url=https://physics.iiserkol.ac.in/fac_hompage.php?did=NnlNa3hIalVNVGN1VjF3UXU5RGFHUkk0RjdWSW5EK053enBWS3NzaXFQOD0= |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=physics.iiserkol.ac.in}}</ref> and Centre of Excellence in Space sciences India (CESSI),<ref>{{Cite web |last=India |first=Center of Excellence in Space Sciences |title=Center of Excellence in Space Sciences India |url=http://www.cessi.in/ |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=Center of Excellence in Space Sciences India |language=en}}</ref> [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Kolkata|Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Kolkata]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=IISER Kolkata - Home |url=https://www.iiserkol.ac.in/web/en/#gsc.tab=0 |access-date=2024-10-19 |website=www.iiserkol.ac.in |language=en}}</ref>

== Awards and recognition ==
Ghosh was awarded the G.G Stokes Award in optical polarization by [[SPIE]] (2021), the international society of optics and photonics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=SPIE G.G. Stokes Award in Optical Polarization |url=https://spie.org/community-support/spie-awards/spie-gg-stokes-award-in-optical-polarization#_=_ |access-date=2025-08-09 |website=spie.org}}</ref> This award is presented for exceptional contribution to the field of optical polarization and related phenomena. In recognition of his overall contributions in the domain of physics, he was elected Fellow of [[Indian Academy of Sciences|Indian Academy of Sciences (FASc)]] in 2022<ref>{{Cite web |title=Indian Academy of Sciences |url=https://fellows.ias.ac.in/profile/v/FL2022013 |access-date=2024-10-24 |website=fellows.ias.ac.in}}</ref> and Fellow of [[National Academy of Sciences, India|National Academy of Sciences, India (FNASc)]] in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elected Fellows of NASI 2022 |url=https://nasi.org.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Fellows-Foreign-Fellows-Elected-2022.pdf }}</ref>
